outcome: Incidence of sepsis caused by Escherichia coli
Antibiotic resistance pattern of Escherichia coli
cohort: 21 neonates with positive blood cultures for Escherichia coli in the first three days of life
finding: Escherichia coli was the most prevalent Gram-negative bacterium isolated in neonates with sepsis in Shiraz, Iran, and meropenem was the most effective antibiotic.
